prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1309; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear quarter and left rear bumper damage on the vehicle lines up well with the impact described by the driver, who was making a left turn when struck. The pattern of crushed panels, cracked lamp housing and scuffed trim fits a single collision, and nothing visible suggests older damage. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, straightening the quarter panel, and refinishing the affected area. The labor hours on the estimate are consistent with the work described, and the supplied invoices show no repeated charges for the same parts or tasks.
